title: Every row has a menu, even Credit Hold and the default COD
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure all twelve standard terms are active and COD is the default for new customers.
  • Start on the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group), Active tab.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the "⋯" at the right of the "Credit Hold" row.
  2. Press Escape.
  3. Click the "⋯" at the right of the "COD" row.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • A menu opens, holding at least "Move Customers".

Step 2:

  • The menu closes.

Step 3:

  • A menu opens, holding at least "Move Customers".
  • Every row on the page has a "⋯" button.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11670 (Story 1, Credit Terms page and list)

  • S1-N3: “Every row has a "⋯" menu, because "Move Customers" appears on every row for every user who can open the page (S2-R1), greyed when it cannot be used. Credit Hold and the default COD row therefore always have a menu.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
